title: Monthly calendar: move availability indicator to bottom of day cell and widen month grid

requirements.text: In the main monthly calendar view, move the availability indicator (the small dot that appears when at least one user has selected availability for that date) to the bottom area of each day cell, so it no longer sits next to the date number.

quotes: 2)the indicator on the monthly calendar showing users when someone has selected an availability on a certain date

acceptanceCriteria: On the month view (CalendarMonthPage), for dates with availability, the indicator renders at the bottom of the day cell (not in the top row next to the numeric date).
The numeric date label remains clearly readable and is not overlapped by the indicator across common viewport sizes.
Existing visual behaviors remain intact: background tint for days with availability and the 'today' border highlight still work as before.

requirements.text: Slightly increase the width of the main monthly calendar component and the 7-column day grid so that numeric day labels are not visually cut off; ensure the month view remains usable on smaller screens (e.g., allow appropriate horizontal space/scrolling rather than clipping).
acceptanceCriteria: In the month view, day numbers are not clipped/cut off at typical narrow and mid-size viewports.
The calendar and the grid have increased effective width (component and grid), without breaking the 7-column layout.
No horizontal clipping occurs inside the card content; if horizontal overflow is necessary on very small screens, the user can access all columns without content being cut off.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only Shadcn components).
Do not modify files listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts/tsx).
nonGoals: Do not change backend availability logic or data models.
Do not change routes or navigation behavior for day detail pages.
Do not implement chat-related layout or ordering changes as part of this request.
